title: Threats again!!!
text:
Threats again!!!"

"Hegseth says US WON'T rule out new 'kinetic strikes' on Iran"

"'If we need to use kinetic strikes... WE'LL USE THEM'"

"Says economic pressure 'hurts most' right now — but if Iran is 'foolish enough' to 'overplay its hand'..."

"...'WE'LL DO WHAT WE NEED TO DO'
